name: supermarket
title: The Supermarket
description: The whole Springfield supermarket for The List: white walls with a red band, shop windows and a wide entrance; four checkout lanes with belts, registers and lane lights; produce tables heaped with fruit; ten aisles of gondolas with end caps and signs; a bakery, a deli case, a dairy cooler wall with glass doors, chest freezers; carts inside and in the corral outside, lamp posts and the pylon.
